_instructions.newsapi: Get free API key from https://newsapi.org/ (100 requests/day, 1 month history)
_instructions.guardian: Get free API key from https://open-platform.theguardian.com/access/ (unlimited, extensive archive back to 1999)
_instructions.nytimes: Get free API key from https://developer.nytimes.com/ (4000 requests/day, extensive archive)
_instructions.alphavantage: Get free API key from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key (news sentiment API)
_instructions.note: Leave any key blank to skip that source. RSS feeds work without any API keys.
